citations.deductible: Sample plan §3.1 — $50 per person each calendar year ($150 family). Waived for preventive services.
citations.annualMax: Sample plan §3.2 — The plan pays up to $1,500 per person each calendar year, plus any MaxRewards rollover.
citations.coinsurance.preventive: Sample plan §4.1 — Preventive services (exams, cleanings, X-rays) are paid at 100%.
citations.coinsurance.basic: Sample plan §4.2 — Basic services (fillings, root canals, extractions) are paid at 80% after the deductible.
